items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Lubinsky was the one that hired me... So we made the date... I let Parker play on every side that there was.

ctx.x:
This was when he sat in because he came around so often naturally, that's how all arrangements were made at that particular time -- small groups -- called head arrangements; which means you had to remember what you did, keep puttin' it together in your head a little more, and sounds as if someone wrote you an arrangement in music, but it's really from the brain.
Then here come this fella Lubinsky, Herman Lubinsky. He and his short self with his beard.
and here he comes and say "Man I want to record you" But it didn't cost nothin' much to record. I think the scale was 44 dollars.
